scope.fine_dem_source: NASA Moon Trek LRO LOLA south-polar DEM, 151 m resampled source

assumptions.slope_threshold_type: assumption; configurable; apply only to fine-resolution pinpoint slope
assumptions.solar_threshold_type: assumption; configurable; evaluated after other hard constraints
assumptions.relay_availability: unknown; Earth visibility is graded, not disqualifying

longest_dark_period.description: Utility reaches zero at approximately one full synodic lunar night.

sunlight_continuity.description: Fraction of candidate 6.5-day mission windows meeting continuous-light requirement

regional_terrain_roughness.label: 1 km terrain-roughness proxy; not landing slope

pinpoint_slope.label: 5 m Barker LDEM slope p90; report valid-data coverage and uncertainty

isru_access.description: Distance to mapped PSR edge is a volatile-access proxy, not ice detection

science_value.label: Neutral Tier C science placeholder
science_value.description: Fixed at 0.5 until an independent geology or spectral layer is ingested; deliberately not derived from terrain slope

thermal_stability.label: Tier C poleward-stability proxy until Diviner data is ingested
thermal_stability.description: Linear latitude proxy: 1 at 90 S and 0 at 80 S; not a temperature measurement.

crew_safety.description: Shown for transparency but folded into terrain_safety to prevent double counting

data_maturity.label: Raster-valid coverage
data_maturity.description: Fraction of valid pixels in the server-resampled export; not native LOLA shot coverage or overall data maturity, and not part of mission suitability

scoring.headline: weighted_geometric_mean
scoring.cluster_selection_note: Operational tunables for forming contiguous map candidates, not mission safety thresholds.

validation.expected_ranking: Site01 has the highest average illumination among Barker Sites 01, 04, 07, and 11
validation.pass_rule: Site01 ranks first by computed average illumination; report FAIL if exact Barker ROI elevations/ephemeris and solar-disk method are not available
